protocol.harness: Build output served on the measuring machine with `wrangler pages dev <outputDir>`; system Google Chrome driven by Playwright (scripts/nimbus/measure.mjs). Legacy and candidate are compared only when measured with the same harness, machine and profile.
protocol.statistic: median of the runs; raw samples are retained with the result

metrics.htmlGzip: gzip -9 bytes of same-origin document responses during load (recorded, not gated).
metrics.jsGzip: gzip -9 bytes of every same-origin script response until 500 ms without same-origin requests in flight after load (includes lazy chunks and worker scripts).
metrics.dataGzip: Same window, every other same-origin response except document, image, font and media (fetch/XHR/JSON/WASM, e.g. a preloaded search index).
metrics.mediaGzip: Same window, image, font and media responses (recorded, not gated).
metrics.searchPayloadGzip: gzip -9 bytes of every same-origin response (any type, including requests made by workers) that arrives from pressing Cmd/Ctrl+K until the dialog text for searchPayloadQuery has been unchanged for searchSettleMs and no same-origin request has been in flight for 500 ms.
metrics.lcp: largest-contentful-paint startTime (ms) observed until network idle + 1 s.
metrics.tbt: Sum over long tasks of (duration - 50 ms) observed until network idle + 1 s.
metrics.searchOpenMs: Wall time from pressing Cmd/Ctrl+K until a visible text input exists inside a dialog (`<dialog open>` or role=dialog). Focus is reported separately as keyboardFocus.
metrics.keyboardFocus: 1 when that input holds keyboard focus 300 ms after the shortcut, else 0 (the candidate must be 1).
metrics.loadAvg1m: Host 1-minute load average when the sample finished (context for timing).

protocol.responseAccounting: The phase of a response is fixed when the response arrives; every body is read before the browser context closes; redirects are skipped; unreadableResponses must be 0 for a valid sample.

budgetRules.bytes: For jsGzip, cssGzip, dataGzip and searchPayloadGzip, the candidate median for each page and profile must be <= the recorded legacy median. Zero tolerance. htmlGzip and mediaGzip are recorded only.
budgetRules.timing: For lcp, tbt and searchOpenMs, run legacy and candidate in the same window on the same machine, alternating per page, and require candidate median <= max(paired legacy median x 1.10, paired legacy median + 50 ms). The recorded timing baseline is informational.
budgetRules.enforcement: Every page and profile is gated; a single exceedance fails the performance gate. Budgets are not re-derived from candidate results and are never relaxed without a recorded decision on #4.

budgetDecisions.reason: The homepage refreshes its new models and release notes after load from /_nimbus/home-feed (about 1.06 KB gzip). Both profiles, both page sets; every other budget is unchanged.

notes: Byte metrics were identical in all 5 runs of every page and profile; unreadableResponses was 0 in every sample.

Timing was recorded on a shared host (1-minute load average 7.7-48.2 across samples); it is informational only and never used as a budget. The timing gate is the paired same-window comparison in budgetRules.timing.
keyboardFocus is 0 on desktop for every page: baseline defect 3 (Cmd/Ctrl+K leaves focus on <body>). The candidate must reach 1.

fullCorpus.recordedFor: #13 full-corpus performance gate. A separate section: protocol and baseline above are the #5 PoC record and stay unchanged.
fullCorpus.protocol: Same as protocol above (harness, runs, profiles, metrics, searchPayloadQuery, searchSettleMs) and the same budgetRules; only the page set differs. Select it with `--set full` in measure.mjs perf and paired-perf.mjs.

notes: Recorded by the lead from the legacy 7b6ef85 build served with wrangler pages dev (the #5 PoC harness), one measure.mjs perf --set full process per page; gatedBytes are per-page medians of 5 runs.
unreadableResponses was 0 in every sample. Byte metrics were identical across runs except: mobile /help/error-codes/ dataGzip: 560/640/560/560/560 (median 560).
The 12 PoC pages reproduce budgets.baseline.gatedBytes exactly, which ties this record to the #5 baseline build.
Timing is informational only (1-minute load average 21.4-92.2 on a shared host); the timing gate is the paired comparison in budgetRules.timing.

Seven pages first measured while the legacy wrangler process degraded before a V8 out-of-memory crash (unreadable responses, short dataGzip) were discarded and re-measured on a fresh process of the same build.
